services.headline: Engineered for Physical Production Tolerances
services.subheadline: We don't deliver rough outlines that only look good on screen. Every file is built to meet the strict physical tolerances of printing presses, screen-printing screens, lasers and CNC blades.
services.c01Desc: Concept art from Midjourney, DALL-E and Ideogram, redrawn with mathematical accuracy. We eliminate pixel haze, remove phantom artifacts and restore natural symmetry.
services.c01Best: Best for: rebrands, agency pitch concepts, apparel logos.
services.c02Desc: Low-resolution scans, photographed business cards and 72 DPI legacy web graphics, rebuilt as infinitely scalable vectors without stair-stepping.
services.c02Best: Best for: archival restorations, legacy client assets.
services.c03Desc: AI lettering is notorious for garbled glyphs. We identify the original typeface, reset the text or hand-draw custom letterforms with optically balanced baselines.
services.c03Best: Best for: monograms, vintage badges, custom wordmarks.
services.c04Desc: Prepared for apparel printing: spot color separations, Pantone Solid Coated callouts, underbase choking and minimum line widths for screen printing.
services.c04Best: Best for: screen printers, merch brands, DTF shops.
services.c05Desc: Fully closed paths, welded intersections, no overlapping paths and consistent path direction to prevent plotter blade gouging.
services.c05Best: Best for: vehicle wraps, sign makers, laser and CNC routers.
services.c06Desc: Streamlined vector paths designed to avoid excessive stitch density, thread breaks and stitch distortion on caps and outerwear.
services.c06Best: Best for: uniform embroiderers, patch manufacturers.

moat.headline: Automatic Tools Convert Pixels. We Rebuild Artwork.
moat.subheadline: Why automatic vectorization software fails once files reach commercial printers, vinyl cutters or embroidery digitizers.
moat.autoTitle: Automatic Image Trace & Free AI Vectorizers
moat.autoPoints: Bloated node counts (10,000+ points): Auto-trace drops an anchor at every pixel stair-step, overloading CNC controllers and laser plotters.
moat.autoCurves: Jittery, non-tangent curves: Circles are never mathematically smooth; straight lines contain tiny ripples.
moat.autoMuddy: Muddy, overlapping polygons: Hundreds of tiny fragments instead of cleanly separated spot color plates.
moat.autoText: Unusable pseudo-lettering: AI characters remain deformed outlines that cannot be edited or cut.
moat.autoResult: Result: Machine jams, rejected print proofs and costly wasted material.
moat.humanPoints: Minimal nodes at extrema: Anchors placed only at curve apexes and inflection points for silky-smooth machine paths.
moat.humanCurves: True mathematical geometry: Circles and arcs are clean Bézier curves; corners are joined and snapped to exact angles.
moat.humanTrapping: Clean spot separations: Separate spot color layers, choked and trapped for screen printing and DTF transfers.
moat.humanText: Matched or hand-drawn typography: AI pseudo-text is replaced with real, razor-sharp typefaces and letterforms.
moat.humanResult: Result: No blade gouging, flawless print registration and unlimited scalability.

howItWorks.headline: Upload. Vectorize. Store. Reuse.
howItWorks.subheadline: From artwork upload to press-ready master files in 3 simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Drop in any raster file (JPG, PNG, WebP or scanned PDF). You see a provisional estimate right away; our studio reviews your artwork and confirms the final price before any work begins.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Experienced artists rebuild every curve with tangent nodes and minimal anchor points. Senior QA verifies closed contours, optical symmetry and production tolerances before delivery.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Approve your preview; once our studio completes delivery, all 5 production-ready formats are unlocked in your private vault:
